title: /harness/data/[...path]
responsibility: Serves the history index and revision details to an admitted request.

inputs.name: GET.event
inputs.description: The SvelteKit RequestEvent of the `/harness/data/[...path]` request; the handler reads only `event.params.path` (`''` when absent) and the policy reads only `event.getClientAddress`. The request is admitted only when `HARNESS_OWNER_MODE` is exactly `loopback`, the bind address (`HARNESS_BIND`, else `HOST`) is a loopback address, `ADDRESS_HEADER` is unset or blank, and `event.getClientAddress()` returns a loopback address; any other request gets 403 Forbidden.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: The `Response` that `consoleServer().json` resolves to: a 403 `text/plain` `Forbidden` when the guard refuses, a 200 `application/json` body for `build.json` or for a stored `index.json`, `activity.json`, `revisions/<commit>.json` or `sides/<commit>.json`, and otherwise a 404 `text/plain` `Not found` (any other path, or a file that is missing or unreadable). Stored JSON is returned as the file's text, except that with `HARNESS_SITE_ROOT` set a `revisions/<commit>.json` body may be re-serialized with recomputed `sourceMeasurements` when a unit lacks its source-bytes or complexity figure for that commit.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by `JSON.parse` in `selectedRevision` when `HARNESS_SITE_ROOT` is set and the `revisions/<commit>.json` file read from `HARNESS_CONSOLE_DATA` is not valid JSON; nothing on the call path catches it, so GET rejects.
